name: Modules.Bluetooth
summary: Allows a Titanium application to use Bluetooth service.
description:
The module is used for connecting your application via bluetooth.

You can download the module at [appcelerator.bluetooth](https://github.com/tidev/appcelerator.bluetooth/releases)

### Getting Started
- Add the module as a dependency to your application by adding a **`<module>`** item to the
  **`[modules](api:Modules)`** element of your `tiapp.xml` file:
  ``` xml
  <ti:app>
    <!-- ... -->
    [modules](api:Modules)
      <module platform="android">appcelerator.bluetooth</module>
    </modules>
    <!-- ... -->
  </ti:app>
  ```
- Use `require()` to access the module from JavaScript:
  ``` javascript
  var bluetooth = require('appcelerator.bluetooth');
  ```
- The `bluetooth` variable is a reference to the module. Make API calls using this reference:
  ``` javascript
  bluetooth.isSupported();
  ```

### Example application
  Please see the /modules/android/appcelerator.bluetooth/x.y.z (version of module)/example folder.

### Observations
- On a bluetooth socket object with a given `uuid`, if device A connects to device B and the same device A tries to create another socket object with the same uuid and attempts to connect with the same device B, then it won't be successful to connect because socket connection is already established between them. Moreover, while attempting for the new connect, the existing connection would also get disconnected. 
  `Recommendation:` It would always be recommended to close the socket connection properly before trying to connect using the newly created socket object on the same device and same uuid.
- When device scanning/discovery is in-progress, the same device can be found multiple times from the deviceFound event in span of 12 seconds. This scenario should be handled by the application. More information refer to deviceFound event and startDiscovery method.

properties.name: address
properties.summary: The hardware address of the local Bluetooth adapter.
properties.description:
For example "00:11:22:AA:BB:CC". This method will only return valid address if the android API < 23.
Otherwise, it will return a constant value of `02:00:00:00:00:00`.

properties.name: DEVICE_TYPE_CLASSIC
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [type](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice#type) property.

properties.name: DEVICE_TYPE_DUAL
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [type](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice#type) property.

properties.name: DEVICE_TYPE_LE
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [type](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice#type) property.

properties.name: DEVICE_TYPE_UNKNOWN
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [type](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice#type) property.

properties.name: name
properties.summary: Friendly name of the local Bluetooth adapter.
properties.description: This name is visible to remote Bluetooth devices. In case of error it can be null.

properties.name: SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [scanMode](api:Modules.Bluetooth#scanMode) property.
properties.description:
This value indicates that inquiry scan is disabled, but page scan is enabled on the local
Bluetooth adapter. Therefore this device is not discoverable from remote Bluetooth devices,
but is connectable from remote Bluetooth devices that have previously discovered this devices.

properties.name: SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE_DISCOVERABLE
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [scanMode](api:Modules.Bluetooth#scanMode) property.
properties.description:
This value indicates that both inquiry scan and page scan are enabled on the local Bluetooth
adapter. Therefore this device is both discoverable and connectable from remote Bluetooth devices.

properties.name: SCAN_MODE_NONE
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [scanMode](api:Modules.Bluetooth#scanMode) property.
properties.description:
This value indicated that both inquiry and page scan is disabled on the local Bluetooth
adapter. Therefore this device neither discoverable nor connectable from the remote Bluetooth
devices.

properties.name: scanMode
properties.summary: The current Bluetooth scan mode of the local Bluetooth adapter.
properties.description:
The Bluetooth scan mode determines if the local adapter is connectable and/or discoverable
from remote Bluetooth devices.
Possible values are [SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE](api:Modules.Bluetooth#SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE),
[SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE_DISCOVERABLE](api:Modules.Bluetooth#SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE_DISCOVERABLE)
and [SCAN_MODE_NONE](api:Modules.Bluetooth#SCAN_MODE_NONE). 
If Bluetooth state is not [STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON), this API will return
[SCAN_MODE_NONE](api:Modules.Bluetooth#SCAN_MODE_NONE).
After turning the Bluetooth on, wait for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged)
event with STATE_ON to get the updated value. If Bluetooth is not supported on the device,
this property returns an error number which is different from the possible values.

properties.name: state
properties.summary: The current state of the local Bluetooth adapter.
properties.description:
Possible values are [STATE_OFF](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_OFF), [STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON),
[STATE_TURNING_OFF](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_TURNING_OFF), [STATE_TURNING_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_TURNING_ON)
If Bluetooth is not supported on the device, this property returns an error number which is different
from the possible values.

properties.name: STATE_OFF
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [state](api:Modules.Bluetooth#state) property. This value indicates that the local Bluetooth adapter is off.
properties.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the
local Bluetooth adapter is off.

properties.name: STATE_ON
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [state](api:Modules.Bluetooth#state) property. This value indicates that the local Bluetooth adapter is on, and ready for use.
properties.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the
local Bluetooth adapter is on.

properties.name: STATE_TURNING_OFF
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [state](api:Modules.Bluetooth#state) property. This value indicates that the local Bluetooth adapter is turning off.
properties.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the
local Bluetooth adapter is turning off.

properties.name: STATE_TURNING_ON
properties.summary: One of the possible values returned by the [state](api:Modules.Bluetooth#state) property. This value indicates that the local Bluetooth adapter is turning on.
properties.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the
local Bluetooth adapter is turning on.

methods.name: cancelDiscovery
methods.summary: Cancels the current device discovery process.
methods.description:
As discovery is a heavyweight procedure for the Bluetooth adapter, this method should
always be called before attempting to connect to a remote device via [connect](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothSocket#connect).
Discovery is run as a system service, so an application should always call cancel discovery
even if it did not directly request a discovery, just to be sure. If Bluetooth state is not
[STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON) or if there is no ongoing discovery process this
function will return false. Listen for the [discoveryFinished](api:Modules.Bluetooth#discoveryFinished)
event to be notified when the device discovery process finished.

returns.summary: true on success, false on error

methods.name: checkBluetoothAddress
methods.summary: Validates a Bluetooth address, such as "00:43:A8:23:10:F0". Alphabetic characters must be uppercase to be valid.

parameters.name: address
parameters.summary: a string representing the address, such as "00:43:A8:23:10:F0".

returns.summary: Returns true if the address is valid, false otherwise.

methods.name: createServerSocket
methods.summary: Creates an object of [BluetoothServerSocket](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket) which can be used to listen for incoming connections.
methods.description:
This method, when called, creates an object of [BluetoothServerSocket](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket)
which can be used to listen for the incoming connection and accept it by calling the
[startAccept](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothServerSocket#startAccept) method. This method
returns null, if Bluetooth is not supported on the device.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: Dictionary which contains value for name, uuid and security level.

properties.name: name
properties.summary: Name of the service for SDP record.

properties.name: secure
properties.summary: Determines whether the connection will be secured.

properties.name: uuid
properties.summary: The UUID of the service for SDP record.

methods.name: disable
methods.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the local
Bluetooth adapter is turning off.

returns.summary: Returns true if the process is initiated successfully or when the bluetooth is already off.

methods.name: enable
methods.description:
Listen for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event to be notified when the local
Bluetooth adapter is turning on.

returns.summary: Returns true if the process is initiated successfully or when the bluetooth is already on.

methods.name: ensureDiscoverable
methods.summary: Make the local device discoverable to other devices.
methods.description:
Displays a system activity that asks the user for permission to make the local device discoverable
by other devices, and to turn on Bluetooth if it is not currently enabled.
Change the scan mode to [SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE_DISCOVERABLE](api:Modules.Bluetooth#SCAN_MODE_CONNECTABLE_DISCOVERABLE).
By default, the device becomes discoverable for 300 seconds, or 5 minutes. You can define a
different duration, up to 3600 seconds or 1 hour.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.summary: It represents the time duration in seconds to make local device discoverable.

methods.name: getName
methods.summary: Gets the friendly Bluetooth name of the local Bluetooth adapter.

returns.summary: Name of the local Bluetooth adapter. In case of error it can be null.

methods.name: getPairedDevices
methods.summary: This method is use to get the devices that are paired to the local Bluetooth adapter.
methods.description:
Returns the [PairedDevicesType](api:PairedDevicesType). In this if the paired devices are
successfully fetched then the [success](api:PairedDevicesType#success) will be true and can get
array of paired devices with the [pairedDevices](api:PairedDevicesType#pairedDevices).
If it is false then we can get description of it via [message](api:PairedDevicesType#message)
If there's any issue fetching paired device, or if there no paired devices then this methods
return false. Refer [message](api:PairedDevicesType#message) for detailed reason of failure.

returns.summary: Dictionary of arguments passed by the method, e.g. success, message and pairedDevices

methods.name: getRemoteDevice
methods.summary: Get a [BluetoothDevice](api:Modules.Bluetooth.BluetoothDevice) object for the given Bluetooth hardware address.
methods.description: If Bluetooth is not supported on the device, this method return null.

parameters.name: address
parameters.summary: Valid Bluetooth hardware addresses must be upper case, in a format such as "00:11:22:33:AA:BB"..

methods.name: isDiscovering
methods.summary: Determines whether the local Bluetooth adapter is currently in the device discovery process or not.
methods.description:
Device discovery is a heavyweight procedure. New connections to remote Bluetooth devices
should not be attempted while discovery is in progress, and existing connections will 
experience limited bandwidth and high latency. Use [cancelDiscovery](api:Modules.Bluetooth#cancelDiscovery)
to cancel an ongoing discovery. If Bluetooth is not supported on the device or Bluetooth 
state is not [STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON) this function will return false.

returns.summary: true if the local Bluetooth adapter is currently in the device discovery process.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.summary: Determines if Bluetooth is currently enabled and ready for use.
methods.description: If Bluetooth is not supported on the device, this method will return false.

returns.summary: Returns true if the local adapter is on.

methods.name: isRequiredPermissionsGranted
methods.summary: Determines whether the required permissions are granted or not.
methods.description:
Checks if the following permissions are defined and have been granted by the user:

* `android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`
* `android.permission.BLUETOOTH`
* `android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN`
* `android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE`
* `android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT`
* `android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN`

If this method returns `false`, then you should call the
[requestPermissions](api:Modules.Bluetooth#requestPermissions) method to display a dialog
requesting permissions from the user.

returns.summary: Returns true if all the permissions are granted.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.summary: Determines whether Bluetooth is supported on the local Bluetooth device.

returns.summary: Returns true if Bluetooth is supported on the device, false otherwise.

methods.name: requestAccessFinePermission
methods.summary: Displays a dialog requesting location permission from the user.
methods.description:
Displays a dialog requesting the user for the `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION` permission.
This permission is required by the [startDiscovery](api:Modules.Bluetooth#startDiscovery) method.
The dialog will not be dispayed if permission has already been granted.

The given optional callback argument and returned `Promise` will provide a `success` property
indicating if permission was granted or not.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Function to be invoked indicating if permission was granted or not.

returns.summary: As of 2.0.0, this method will return a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.

methods.name: requestPermissions
methods.summary: Displays a dialog requesting all permissions needed by the bluetooth module from the user.
methods.description:
Displays a dialog requesting the user for the `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION` permission.
Will also request the `BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE`, `BLUETOOTH_CONNECT`, and `BLUETOOTH_SCAN` permissions
if running on Android 12 or higher. These permission are required by this module to
discover devices and to make the app's device discoverable by other devices.

The given optional callback argument and returned `Promise` will provide a `success` property
indicating if permissions were granted or not.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Function to be invoked indicating if permissions were granted or not.

returns.summary: Returns a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.

methods.name: setName
methods.summary: Sets the friendly Bluetooth name of the local Bluetooth adapter.
methods.description:
The Bluetooth adapter must be turned on before you can set the name. After turning the Bluetooth
on, wait for the [stateChanged](api:Modules.Bluetooth#stateChanged) event with [STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON)
to get the updated value.

parameters.name: name
parameters.summary: Name for the local Bluetooth adapter. Bluetooth names can be maximum of 248 bytes using UTF-8 encoding. Although, it may vary upon Bluetooth devices. Some can only display first 40 characters, and some may be limited to just 20.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.summary: Starts the remote device discovery process.
methods.description:
This method starts the discovery for the nearby Bluetooth devices. The process of the discovery
takes upto 12 seconds.This is an asynchronous call, it will return immediately. Register for
[discoveryStarted](api:Modules.Bluetooth#discoveryStarted) and [discoveryFinished](api:Modules.Bluetooth#discoveryFinished)
events to determine exactly when discovery starts and completes. Register for [deviceFound](api:Modules.Bluetooth#deviceFound)
event to be notified when a nearby device is found. From API level 29 and above make sure
that the location services is on in the device to start the scanning process. Device discovery
will only find remote devices that are currently in discoverable mode. Many Bluetooth devices
are not discoverable by default, and need to be entered into a discoverable mode. This method may
return same device multiple times from the `deviceFound` event in span of 12 seconds.
If Bluetooth state is not [STATE_ON](api:Modules.Bluetooth#STATE_ON) or the required permission
not granted than this function will return false.

returns.summary: Returns true to indicate success, or false on immediate error.

events.name: deviceFound
events.summary: Fired when the local Bluetooth adapter discovers a device.

properties.name: device
properties.summary: The discovered Bluetooth device.

properties.name: RSSI
properties.summary: The RSSI value at the time of device discovery.

events.name: discoveryFinished
events.summary: Fired when the local Bluetooth adapter finished discovery.

events.name: discoveryStarted
events.summary: Fired when the local Bluetooth adapter started discovery.

events.name: stateChanged
events.summary: Fired when the state of the local Bluetooth adapter changes.
events.description: Most possible reason for this event to occur is either bluetooth is turning on or off.
